Introduction
Northbridge Technologies Inc. (“Northbridge,” “we,” “our ,” or “us”) is a vertically in-
tegrated electric utility headquartered in Ohio. We generate, transmit, and distribute
electricity to retail and wholesale customers within our regulated service territory .

regulatory authorities, and our business is organized to support reliable, long-term
